headline: CREATOR BUDGETS REACH 44 BILLION DOLLARS THIS YEAR, 36 PERCENT OF THE PEOPLE SPENDING IT SAY THEY CANNOT SEE HOW MUCH ACTUALLY REACHES THE CREATOR, AND 74 PERCENT AGREE THAT IS BECAUSE SOMEBODY IN THE MIDDLE IS PAID TO KEEP IT THAT WAY
deck: The advertising industry's own trade body surveyed 53 senior people who run creator marketing and published the answers yesterday.  They say the money has arrived and the plumbing has not.  The sharpest finding is not the 44 billion dollars.  It is that a majority of the people inside the business think the confusion is somebody's business model.
tldr: The advertising industry's own trade body surveyed 53 senior creator-marketing people and published it yesterday: creator budgets are expected to hit 44 billion dollars this year, 67 percent say measurement is what is broken, 36 percent cannot see how much of the spend reaches the creator, and 74 percent agree the confusion persists because somebody benefits from it.  The mechanism is that last-click models built for paid media cap creator budgets regardless of performance.  Write your own definition of a view, the fee split and one assisted measure into your next creator contract before you discuss money.

Maybelline's Lifter Gel went from under 5 percent of its lip product unit sales in May to more than 30 percent in July, with weekly sales up tenfold between the Love Island premiere and finale, and the executive running it has banned the word sponsorship from her team because the show airs nearly every night.  Pick your next partnership on how many days out of thirty the audience meets the content, and favour a daily property over a bigger weekly one.

OpenAI switched on brand dashboards inside ChatGPT yesterday, and the first live ones show 690 mentions producing 24 clicks at one business and 28 mentions producing one click at another, while OpenAI's demonstration dashboard shows 15,356 mentions and 5,432 clicks.  Claim your profile this week so the counter starts, then make it a rule that mentions and clicks only ever appear together in a report.

Grace Wells spends about 100 hours on one branded video, 30 of them before filming and only 20 in the edit, because the brand signs off a shot-by-shot storyboard and the music is locked before anything is storyboarded.  Put a storyboard approval gate in your next creator contract, name and sign off the music track at that gate, and treat changes to it afterwards as a change order rather than feedback.

ITV's streaming viewing hours are up 29 percent while its digital advertising is up 6 percent, and yesterday it took 25 million pounds out of this quarter's content budget and guided fourth-quarter advertising down 5 to 10 percent.  Reopen your rate conversation on any ITV commitment this quarter and ask for streaming and addressable weight as the make-good, since digital is the only growing line.

Paramount Skydance will stop publishing quarterly subscriber totals from February 2027, which removes the independent denominator under every reach and frequency claim about Paramount Plus, in a quarter where its linear advertising fell 8 percent and its streaming advertising rose 13.2 percent to 542 million dollars.  Document your reach and frequency assumptions against the published figures this month and keep the source.

GTA 6 lands on 19 November and the benchmark is the August reveal at 3.97 million peak viewers and 5.2 million hours watched, with 20.2 percent of those hours on Kick.  Book your creators for launch week by Friday, ask every one of them for a peak and an average concurrent figure rather than hours watched, and put a small deliberate test on Kick that week.

The advertising industry's own trade body surveyed 53 senior people who run creator marketing and published the answers yesterday.  They say the money has arrived and the plumbing has not.  The sharpest finding is not the 44 billion dollars.  It is that a majority of the people inside the business think the confusion is somebody's business model.

The mechanism is that last-click models built for paid media cap creator budgets regardless of performance.
